name: DMD 4475
title: Web and Interactive Media Design Practicum
description: Digital technology is ever-changing and so too are techniques and workflows required in the production of web and interactive media projects. Through the completion of real-world projects, this course examines emerging technologies and techniques in the world of web and interactive media design. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: DMD 3470 and 3475; open to Digital Media and Design majors only, others with instructor consent. Recommended preparation: DMD 4470.
